title: A text memo is written into the JSON export without a UTF-8 check (invalid bytes become U+FFFD)
severity_basis: Lossy export of a field the ledger carries as arbitrary bytes (Go's encoding/json replaces invalid UTF-8 with U+FFFD) while tx_envelope keeps the bytes. No halt: the JSON encoder does not fail on it.

entries.expected: memo bytes exported without loss, or flagged
entries.observed: XDR103 at internal/transform/transaction.go:247 (TransformTransaction): xdr.Memo.MustText() carries submitter-controlled bytes into the JSON field TransactionOutput.Memo without a UTF-8 check (make lint-stellar-etl); the exported memo of a non-UTF-8 text memo contains U+FFFD.

evidence.pre_fix: make lint-stellar-etl (xdrlint built with the Go toolchain stellar-etl requires): XDR103 at internal/transform/transaction.go:247, suppressed with this record as its finding. Still present at release-v20261117 (a046ba53).
evidence.expected_basis: Memo text is string<28> in the XDR definitions (https://github.com/stellar/stellar-xdr/blob/v30.0/Stellar-transaction.x#L778): arbitrary bytes, not required to be UTF-8; Go's encoding/json replaces invalid UTF-8 with U+FFFD, so the exported value is not the ledger's.

reproduction.method: Independent reviewer reproduction from the record alone: 1 of 1 listed report rows failed again as recorded, offline. Checked again at a046ba53 before filing.

approval.scope: Public issue on stellar/stellar-etl (#504): the memo column holds U+FFFD for a non-UTF-8 text memo while tx_envelope keeps the bytes.
